notes: v0.1.3 uses user-confirmed default payment-channel assumptions for Go and Pulse.
CardMax includes credit-card transactions from both manhu budget and dogi budget.
HSBC Red online reward progress is tracked by the 3.6% extra RewardCash pool: HK$360 extra RC corresponds to the first HK$10,000 eligible online spend.

HSBC Red Visa/Mastercard non-HKD transactions use an estimated 1.95% foreign-currency transaction fee. HKD transactions made outside Hong Kong or with merchants not registered in Hong Kong may use a 1% reimbursement fee; CardMax applies this only when merchant location can be inferred with confidence.
AEON local dining and local transport are tracked as separate HK$100 monthly extra-reward pools under the registered Purple lifestyle promotion; mobile payment is the default optimisation assumption.
AEON Mainland/Macau/Taiwan and other overseas/foreign-currency promotions are tracked separately at HK$100 and HK$200 monthly extra-reward caps respectively for Aug-Oct 2026.
For non-HKD/CNY currencies, CardMax does not invent an FX rate; exact HKD progress remains unavailable until an HKD-equivalent conversion source is added.
Bank rules are configuration data and should be reviewed monthly before updating this file.
